chest-dip.criteria: Parallel bars, forward trunk lean20-30 degrees, knees bent back, elbows approximately90 at bottom, controlled press without lockout.

hanging-knee-raise.criteria: Overhand hang on fixed bar, raise bent knees toward chest without swinging, controlled lowering.

reverse-grip-pushdown.criteria: Underhand straight-bar grip; upper arms fixed beside torso, extend elbows, hold and controlled return.

limits: Procedural shared human and simplified equipment; new exercise-specific motions. Sampled geometry is not full mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Local only; production and device pending.
